question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a black present, Bob has a white present, Claire has a teal present, Dave has a red present, Eve has a yellow present, Fred has a purple present, and Gertrude has a green present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Dave and Gertrude swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Gertrude swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Bob swap their gifts. Finally, Claire and Dave swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Claire has the
Options:
(A) black present
(B) white present
(C) teal present
(D) red present
(E) yellow present
(F) purple present
(G) green present
solution:
Gift colors in holder order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude):
Initial: (black, white, teal, red, yellow, purple, green)
1. Dave swaps with Gertrude: (black, white, teal, green, yellow, purple, red)
2. Alice swaps with Bob: (white, black, teal, green, yellow, purple, red)
3. Bob swaps with Alice: (black, white, teal, green, yellow, purple, red)
4. Fred swaps with Gertrude: (black, white, teal, green, yellow, red, purple)
5. Eve swaps with Fred: (black, white, teal, green, red, yellow, purple)
6. Alice swaps with Bob: (white, black, teal, green, red, yellow, purple)
7. Claire swaps with Dave: (white, black, green, teal, red, yellow, purple)
Claire has the green present, option (G).
Final answer: (G)
